concepts.def: Sum of values ÷ number of values
1 unit lowers blood glucose by a set amount

walkthroughs.body_html:
Run a ruler drop test 5 times.

Times in s: 0.22, 0.18, 0.21, 0.19, 0.20. Mean = sum ÷ 5 = 1.00 ÷ 5 = 0.20 s.

Repeat with caffeine to compare.

BMI = mass ÷ height². 80 kg ÷ (1.6 × 1.6) = 80 ÷ 2.56 ≈ 31.25 — obese range.

BMI 18.5–25 is healthy.

Type 1: 1 unit per 10 g carb. A meal with 75 g carbs needs 7.5 units.

Always read the label and confirm with carer where required.
